people.name: A. Charles Muller
people.field: Korean Buddhism and East Asian Yogacara

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: Muller first took college classes at the University of Dayton in 1971, on a pre-med path. However, he later dropped out.

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: In 1980 he returned to college at Suffolk County Community College, where he studied for a year before transferring to Stony Brook University.

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: transferring to Stony Brook University. Muller's academic study of Buddhism began at Stony Brook, where he majored in Religious Studies

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: Muller's academic study of Buddhism began at Stony Brook, where he majored in Religious Studies under the guidance of Sung Bae Park

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: spent one year in the graduate program in Religious Studies at the University of Virginia. In 1988, he left UVA to return to Stony Brook

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: In 1988, he left UVA to return to Stony Brook, where he completed a PhD in Comparative literature... His dissertation, "Hamhŏ Kihwa: A Study of His Major Works," was accepted in 1993

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: where he completed a PhD in Comparative literature, once again with Sung Bae Park as his principal advisor.

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: He also studied Christian Theology with Peter Manchester

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: and postmodern literary criticism with Michael Sprinker and Hugh Silverman.

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: From 1994 to 2008, Muller taught courses in philosophy and religion at Toyo Gakuen University

relations.subject: A. Charles Muller
relations.evidence: In 2008, Muller was invited to join the Faculty of Humanities at the University of Tokyo... He retired from UTokyo in March 2019
